transparencyAdvisory.interpretation: Only pixels with alpha exactly 0 are counted. Preserve these advisory entries and reviewed PNGs; main Renderer must inspect actual edge filtering.

budget.samplingEstimateMethod: Actual in-memory full-canvas sampled PNG bytes, multiplied by 4/3 base64 and 1.2 atlas allowance, plus 256KiB atlas metadata. Final package measured by main.

registrationEvidence: Source annotated foot/center affine map and per-frame anchor/canvas/scale checked; actual natural motion and edge filtering remain with main Renderer.
